book.name: Joŋ
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Joŋ gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Ba to bɛ kwɛse wumu fɛ Jiso le ba kole wu gwɛŋ wu kinjaŋ le
Jiso ja wu bɛɛŋ fie nyu yi Mbegɛ wu Bite bi Olif le.
Akfuuŋ bu a yuu, wu ka wu kaasɛ wu gɛɛŋ fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le. Bamii bachii taashɛ mbebe ye le, wu mo wu shii fɛkuu wu tu wu yɛyi bo.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi bɛ Bafalashii ja bo to bɛ kwɛse wumu wu ba kole wu wu gime bɛ jwɛŋsɛ wumu. No bo to bɛ wu, bo leesɛ wu a bo fwe,
bo jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Muh N'yɛyɛ, kwɛse wunɛ le ba koo wu, wu gime bɛ jwɛŋsɛ wumu.
A banchi le, Musɛ gɛ̀ du lɛ wunɛ kwɛse le wu ba tumɛ lo bɛ ata wu kwe. Wo le wo jɛmɛ fiuŋ lɛ la?”
Bo gɛ̀ gee noo bo tele lo Jiso laa wu lé wu lôŋsɛ njɛmɛ bo mo bo kɛ̂me fiɛɛ fì bo kôoyi yi ye ye le lɛ. Geenɛ, Jiso ŋgvuusɛ wu tu wu saŋe fiɛɛ fɛkuu bɛ nyi yi kwaŋ.
Bo mɛ gɛh bo lɛme fo bo dode. Wu ja wu lɛɛŋ we wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ muh le yu a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ wù kɛme gɛ kimbefɛ gɛ, wù nyu muh wù fwe wù to wu ya wu tuŋ kwɛse wunɛ bɛ tɛdɛ.”

content: No Jiso jɛmɛ noo, wu ka wu kaasɛ wu ŋgvuusɛ wu tu wu saŋe fiɛɛ fɛkuu bɛ nyi yi kwaŋ.
No bo yu fiɛɛ fì Jiso jɛme, bo mo bo kɛ bo tu bo saaŋe wu mumwaa wu mumwaa bo gɛɛne kɛge yi ŋgaamii le. Bo saaŋe noo, kwɛse wɛɛ shɛɛ wu tu wu lɛme fo bɛ Jiso maa.
Jiso kaasɛ wu lɛɛŋ we, wu biih kwɛse wɛɛ le lɛ,

content.text: “Kwɛse, bo le faaŋ? Muh baaŋ nyu gɛ yu wu du lɛ wo kɛme gɛh ki wo kwê gɛ?”

content: Wu chvuu lɛ, “Muh baaŋ nyu gɛ yu gɛ, Tada.” Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ taŋlo ndu tɛ lɛ wo kɛme ki wo kwê gɛ. Gɛ̂nɛ la, geenɛ keefɛ wo gɛ̂ɛŋ wo ka wo gêe kimbefɛ gɛ.]”

content: Jiso le n'yulɛ wu yi woŋ le
Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ bamii baa le lɛ,

content.text: “Le mɛ wù le n'yulɛ wu yi woŋ kfunɛ le. No nyu yɛɛŋ wu bii mɛne gɛ taŋlo wu jiɛnyi kijibɛ le gɛ. Wu lé wu kɛ̂mɛ n'yulɛ wù nyaa kinche bamii le.”

content: Bafalashii mo bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Wo bɛɛyi jiŋ yi nsa fɛ kikwɛɛ kuŋ le. Fiɛɛ fì wo jɛme gɛ fi kooji gɛ.”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Mɛ, nɛ mbɛɛyi jiŋ yi nsa fɛ kikwɛɛ kaŋ le, tu fiɛɛ fì njɛme kooji lo, nje ŋkee fɛ nja fo, ŋkee tɛ fɛ ŋgɛɛne fo. Geenɛ, gɛ bɛŋ kee fɛ nja fo gɛ, kɛnɛ fɛ ŋgɛɛne fo gɛ.
Bɛŋ sage bamii njɛ bamii ba wuŋ. Gɛ nsage fiaŋ muh gɛ.
Geenɛ, mbe nsage lo muh, tu nsage a je yì kooji le, nje gɛ nsage mɛ maa gɛ. Nsage besa Chii wù tuŋ mɛ.
A ŋwa wene wu banchi le ba le ba saŋ lɛ, nɛ bamii bɛɛyi jiŋ yi nsa wu fiɛɛ bafɛɛ, tu le nchiɛɛŋ.
Mbɛɛyi jiŋ yi nsa fɛ kikwɛɛ kaŋ le, Chii wù tuŋ mɛ bɛɛ tɛ jiŋ yi nsa waŋ.”

content: Bo mo bo biih wu le lɛ, “Chijo le faaŋ?” Jiso chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ bɛŋ kee mɛ gɛ kɛnɛ Chijaŋ gɛ. Nɛ bɛŋ be kee mɛ, tu bɛŋ be kee tɛ Chijaŋ.”

content: Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme mwɛɛ munɛ no wu gɛ̀ yɛyi bamii fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le mbebe fɛ bo to bo nyaa bige bi yeh yi kintanyɛ le. Geenɛ, muh gɛ̀ baaŋ koo gɛ wu gɛ, nje kife ke gɛ̀ baaŋ a kojɛ gɛ.
Jiso dunyɛ lɛ wu ja fɛwe
Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nlé ŋgê ŋgɛ̂ɛŋ, bɛŋ shɛ̂ɛ bɛŋ gôoŋ mɛ bɛŋ jiɛnyɛ bɛŋ kwe bɛ bimbefɛ biɛna. Fɛ ŋgɛɛne fo gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ to fo gɛ.”

content: Bajuu mo bo biih lɛ, Wu lé wu gê wu yûuyɛ kikwɛɛ ke, no wu du lɛ,

content.text: “Fɛ ŋgɛɛne fo gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ to fo gɛ?”

content: Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ ja fɛkuu fɛnɛ, nja fiaŋ fɛwe. Bɛŋ le bamii ba le ba yi woŋ kfunɛ le. Gɛ mɛ nyu muh wu yi woŋ kfunɛ le gɛ.
Njɛmɛ wa lɛ bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ kwêeyɛ antɛnɛɛ a bimbefɛ biɛna. Bɛŋ kêe lɛ bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ kwêeyɛ antɛnɛɛ a bimbefɛ biɛna fɛnɛ bɛŋ baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ lɛ le mɛ wuyu gɛ.”

content: Bo biih wu le lɛ, “Le wo wu yɛɛŋ?” Jiso chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Nle muh wù nchi nto nsɛŋe bɛŋ le kune wu kɛge fɛŋkɛɛ.
Ŋkɛme mwɛɛ wesee mù ntaŋlo njɛme kune bɛŋ bɛ mwɛɛ wesee mù ntaŋlo nsa bɛŋ yu. Geenɛ, muh wù tuŋ mɛ le muh wù nchiɛɛŋ. Fiɛɛ fì nsɛŋe woŋ le le fì n'yu a wu le.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, bo gɛ kɛɛ lɛ wu jɛme bo le nyu kune Chiji gɛ.
Noo Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Sege bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ shɛ̂ŋshɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh fɛwe, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ kɛɛ lɛ le mɛ wuyu, bɛ lɛ gɛ ŋgee fiɛɛ fimi a bvuŋga bwaŋ le gɛ, lɛ njɛme nɛ le noo no Chii yɛyi mɛ.
Muh wù tuŋ mɛ le besa wu. Gɛ wu baaŋ wu chine mɛne lɛ mɛ nyu mɛ maa gɛ, nje nto ŋgee fiɛɛ segechii nyu fì joŋe fɛ wu le.”

content: No Jiso gɛ̀ jɛmɛ mwɛɛ munɛ nɛ, bamii ba duude lee muntele yi ye ye le.
Nchiɛɛŋ mbvuuse bamii bvunfa le
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ wa nyu Bajuu ba gɛ̀ leesɛ muntele yi ye ye le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ nɛ mɛ gɛh bɛŋ lɛme yi jɛ yaŋ le, bɛŋ nyûme bamii baŋ ba nchiɛɛŋ ba ŋgoo,
bɛŋ mo bɛŋ kɛɛ nchiɛɛŋ wuyu wu ge bɛŋ bu yi bvunfa le.”

content: Bo chvuu wu le lɛ, “Bee le kfuu chi Ablaham, bee gɛ̀ baaŋ a nyu gɛ nfa chiaaŋ yi muh mu le gɛ. Fi jiɛnyi nɛɛ fɛ wo duu lɛ bee lé be gê be bû yi bvunfa le?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ muh wuchii wù gee kimbefɛ le nfwa wu kimbefɛ.
Gɛ nfwa to wu mɛ gɛh wù nyu muh wu yeh yi wu le yu segechii gɛ. Le mɛ gɛh mwa yeh wù to wù nyu muh wu yeh yiyu le segechii.
Noo, nɛ Mwa bvuse bɛŋ yi bvunfa le, tu bɛŋ le bɛŋ bu wa bvu le nchiɛɛŋ.
Ŋkee lɛ bɛŋ le kiŋgogɛ ki Ablaham, geenɛ bɛŋ goone gɛh ki bɛŋ yûuyɛ mɛ nje gɛ jɛ yaŋ kɛme kijusɛ yi ye yene le gɛ.
Njɛme nyu fiɛɛ fì n'yɛŋ a Chii le, bɛŋ gee fiena nyu fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ yu a chiji wene le.”

content: Bo chvuu wu le lɛ, “Ablaham le Chiji wese.” Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ bɛŋ bee booŋ ba Ablaham, tu bɛŋ be bɛŋ gee fiɛɛ nyu fi Ablaham gɛ̀ gee.
Nle nsɛɛŋ bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ wu n'yu a Nyo le. Geenɛ, mɛɛse bɛŋ goone ki bɛŋ yûuyɛ lo mɛ, gɛ finɛ fiɛɛ nyu fi fì Ablaham gɛ̀ gee gɛ.
Bɛŋ gee nyu fiɛɛ fì chiji wene gee.”

content: Bo, jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Gɛ bee nyu booŋ ba ba boyi kuu gɛ. Bee kɛme Chiji wese wu mumwaa, nyu Nyo.”
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ Nyo be bee nyu chiji wene, tu bɛŋ be koŋe mɛ, nje nja nyu fɛ Nyo le, fɛ nto. Gɛ nto a bvuŋga bwaŋ le gɛ. Tuŋ wu mɛ.
Le nje la fi bɛŋ yuge gɛ fiɛɛ fì njɛme gɛ? Gɛ nyu nje bɛŋ le bɛŋ faŋ ki bɛŋ yû jɛ yaŋ le?

Bɛŋ le booŋ bachiji wene wu debele, fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ goone le ki bɛŋ gêe nyu fiɛɛ fì chiji wene goone. Wu gɛ̀ bee wa muh wù yuuyi bamii kɛge lo fɛŋkɛɛ. Gɛ wu kɛme fiɛɛ ki wu gê bɛ nchiɛɛŋ gɛ, nje gɛ nchiɛɛŋ nyu lo yi ye ye le gɛ. Wu ge doo wu mbiane chimbiaŋ wu jɛme gɛh nyu no gee che le, nje wu le muh wu chimbiaŋ wù nyu chiji chimbiaŋ.
Geenɛ, nsɛŋe fiaŋ nyu nchiɛɛŋ, le fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ mɛne gɛ.
Le yɛɛŋ a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ wu taŋlo wu dunyɛ fiɛɛ fì befe fì nle ŋge? No, fiɛɛ fì nsɛŋe bɛŋ le le nchiɛɛŋ, ge la lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ bɛ̂ɛŋ mɛne gɛ?
Muh wu le muh wù Nyo wu to wu yuge jɛ yi Nyo. Fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ yuge gɛ jɛ yi Nyo gɛ le nje gɛ bɛŋ nyu bamii ba Nyo gɛ.”

content: Jiso gɛ̀ bee wa fɛ Ablaham wù nyu
Bajuu mo bo jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Gɛ bee be be sɛɛŋ wa nchiɛɛŋ lɛ wo nɛ wo nyu muh wu Samaliya nchɛndaa debele nyu yi ye yo le gɛ?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ nchɛndaa wu debele nyu yi ye yaŋ le gɛ. Ŋgvuune fiaŋ Chii, geenɛ bɛŋ ŋgvuune gɛ mɛ gɛ.
Gɛ ŋgôone mbɛɛŋsɛ fɛ kikwɛɛ kaŋ le gɛ. Muh le yu wu mumwaa wù goone fiɛɛ fiyu, nyu wu wù suune bansa.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ muh nɛ yuge jɛ yaŋ, wu gɛ yu wu to wu kwe gɛ.”

content: Bajuu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Bee le be kɛɛ wa mɛɛse lɛ nchɛndaa wu debele le yi ye yo le. Ablaham gɛ̀ kwe wa, bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo kweeyɛ tɛ, wo tu wo duu lɛ muh yuge jɛ yo le, wu gɛ ka wu yu wu to wu kwe gɛ.
Wo fede chiji wese wù Ablaham wù gɛ̀ kwe wa, wo fede tɛ bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo ba gɛ̀ kweeyɛ baa? Wo kwaji lɛ wo le la?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ le lɛ mbɛɛŋse kikwɛɛ kaŋ, tu fifiɛɛ le achiji. Le Chii wù bɛɛŋse mɛ, nyu wu wù bɛŋ duu lɛ le Nyo wene.
Geenɛ, gɛ bɛŋ kee wu gɛ. Kee gɛh mɛ wù. Nɛ nja njɛme lɛ gɛ ŋkee wu gɛ, tu nle muh wu chimbiaŋ njɛ bɛŋ. Geenɛ, no fi le, le mɛ wù kee wu, n'yuge jɛ ye le.
Chiji wene wù Ablaham gɛ̀ bee wu laŋeye lɛ wu lé wu gê wu yɛ̂ŋ aju a waŋ le. Wu gɛ̀ yɛŋ, wu yuge njoŋ.”

content: Bajuu mo bo jaŋe lɛ, “Wo le njɛ wo bu wa biluŋ mbaanshɛŋ sɛŋ, tu nyu lɛ wo gɛ̀ yɛŋ wa Ablaham le?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, fɛ Ablaham gɛ̀ bee ki wù nyu, mɛ nyume wa.”

content: Bo yu noo, bo mo bo jo ata lɛ bo tumɛ Jiso yu. Jiso mo wu nyilɛ wu bu yeh yi kintanyɛ le.

footnotes.text: Jee che le lɛ, “Nyume” le chi chì Nyo gɛ̀ jɛmɛ Musɛ le lɛ le jee wu wù Nyo lɛ (Kinsaŋ 3:14).
